title: Morning Brief — Thursday, 12 November 2026
description: Virgin Australia and Qatar Airways look to expand their Doha partnership, the Brisbane Heat prepare for the new Big Bash League season under a new coach, and a major new manufacturing facility breaks ground at Yatala on the Gold Coast. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
